summary: The filing is a Form 6-K report by Lloyds Banking Group plc disclosing a routine PDMR share disposal. On 30 April 2026, director Chirantan Barua sold 512,681 ordinary shares at 97.108 pence each. The sale is part of normal shareholding compliance and does not represent a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or structural changes are mentioned. The filing is simply a regulatory notification of an insider transaction with no broader corporate event.
